Strategy: Count-gated worst fit: with five or more feasible bins use worst fit, spreading the item into the roomiest bin, and with fewer bins use tightest fit; a large open pool can afford spreading while a small pool must consolidate. It can fail when spreading in a large pool fragments bins that later items needed tight.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if len(bins) >= 5 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
